verses.zh: 我们被掳掠第二十五年，耶路撒冷城攻破后十四年，正在年初，月之初十日，耶和华的灵（原文是手）降在我身上，他把我带到以色列地。
verses.en: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city[NOTE:1] was struck down, on this very day,[NOTE:2] the hand[NOTE:3] of the Lord was on me, and he brought me there.[NOTE:4]
notes: Or “power.” sn Hand in the OT can refer metaphorically to power, authority, or influence. In Ezekiel God’s hand being on the prophet is regularly associated with communication or a vision from God (3:14, 22; 8:1; 37:1; 40:1).
That is, to the land of Israel (see v. 2).

verses.zh: 在　神的异象中带我到以色列地，安置在至高的山上；在山上的南边有彷佛一座城建立。
verses.en: By divine visions[NOTE:1] he brought me to the land of Israel and placed me on a very high mountain,[NOTE:2] and on it was a structure like a city, to the south.
notes: The expression introduces the three major visions of Ezekiel (1:1; 8:3; 40:2).
The reference to a very high mountain is harmonious with Isa 2:2.

verses.zh: 他带我到那里，见有一人，颜色（原文是形状）如铜，手拿麻绳和量度的竿，站在门口。
verses.en: When he brought me there, I saw[NOTE:1] a man whose appearance was like bronze, with a linen cord and a measuring stick in his hand. He was standing in the gateway.
notes: The word הִנֵּה (hinneh, traditionally “behold”) indicates becoming aware of something and has been translated here as a verb.

verses.zh: 那人对我说：「人子啊，凡我所指示你的，你都要用眼看，用耳听，并要放在心上。我带你到这里来，特为要指示你；凡你所见的，你都要告诉以色列家。」
verses.en: The man said to me, “Son of man, watch closely, listen carefully, and pay attention[NOTE:1] to everything I show you, for you have been brought here so that I can show it to you.[NOTE:2] Tell the house of Israel everything you see.”
notes: Heb “look with your eyes, hear with your ears, and set your mind on.”
Heb “in order to show (it) to you.”

verses.zh: 我见殿四围有墙。那人手拿量度的竿，长六肘，每肘是一肘零一掌。他用竿量墙，厚一竿，高一竿。
verses.en: I saw[NOTE:1] a wall all around the outside of the temple.[NOTE:2] In the man’s hand was a measuring stick 10½ feet[NOTE:3] long. He measured the thickness of the wall[NOTE:4] as 10½ feet[NOTE:5] and its height as 10½ feet.
notes: The word הִנֵּה (hinneh, traditionally “behold”) indicates becoming aware of something and has been translated here as a verb.

Heb “a measuring stick of 6 cubits, [each] a cubit and a handbreadth.” The measuring units here and in the remainder of this section are the Hebrew “long” cubit, consisting of a cubit (about 18 inches or 45 cm) and a handbreadth (about 3 inches or 7.5 cm), for a total of 21 inches (52.5 cm). Therefore the measuring stick in the man’s hand was 10.5 feet (3.15 meters) long. Because modern readers are not familiar with the cubit as a unit of measurement, and due to the additional complication of the “long” cubit as opposed to the regular cubit, all measurements have been converted to American standard feet and inches, with the Hebrew measurements and the metric equivalents given in the notes.
Heb “one rod [or “reed”]” (also a second time in this verse, twice in v. 6, three times in v. 7, and once in v. 8).

verses.zh: 他到了朝东的门，就上门的台阶，量门的这槛，宽一竿；又量门的那槛，宽一竿。
verses.en: Then he went to the gate facing east. He climbed its steps and measured the threshold of the gate as 10½ feet deep.[NOTE:1]
notes: The Hebrew text adds “the one threshold 10½ feet deep.” This is probably an accidental duplication of what precedes. See D. I. Block, Ezekiel (NICOT), 2:517.

verses.zh: 又有卫房，每房长一竿，宽一竿，相隔五肘。门槛，就是挨着向殿的廊门槛，宽一竿。
verses.en: The alcoves were 10½ feet long and 10½ feet wide; between the alcoves were 8¾ feet.[NOTE:1] The threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate facing inward was 10½ feet.
notes: Heb “5 cubits” (i.e., 2.625 meters) according to the “long” cubit. See the note on the first occurrence of the phrase “10½ feet” in v. 5.

verses.zh: 他又量向殿门的廊子，宽一竿。
verses.en: Then he measured the porch of the gate facing inward as 10½ feet.

verses.zh: 又量门廊，宽八肘，墙柱厚二肘；那门的廊子向着殿。
verses.en: He measured the porch of the gate as 14 feet[NOTE:1] and its jambs as 3½ feet;[NOTE:2] the porch of the gate faced inward.

verses.zh: 东门洞有卫房：这旁三间，那旁三间，都是一样的尺寸；这边的柱子和那边的柱子，也是一样的尺寸。
verses.en: There were three alcoves on each side of the east gate; the three had the same measurement, and the jambs on either side had the same measurement.[NOTE:1]
notes: The three alcoves are parallel to the city gates found at Megiddo, Hazor, and Gezer.

verses.zh: 他量门口，宽十肘，长十三肘。
verses.en: He measured the width of the entrance of the gateway as 17½ feet[NOTE:1] and the length of the gateway as 22¾ feet.[NOTE:2]

verses.zh: 卫房前展出的境界：这边一肘，那边一肘；卫房这边六肘，那边六肘。
verses.en: There was a barrier in front of the alcoves, 1¾ feet[NOTE:1] on either side; the alcoves were 10½ feet[NOTE:2] on either side.

verses.zh: 又量门洞，从这卫房顶的后檐到那卫房顶的后檐，宽二十五肘；卫房门与门相对。
verses.en: He measured the gateway from the roof of one alcove to the roof of the other, a width of 43¾ feet[NOTE:1] from one entrance to the opposite one.

verses.zh: 又量（原文是造）廊子六十肘（七十士译本是二十肘），墙柱外是院子，有廊为界，在门洞两边。
verses.en: He measured[NOTE:1] the porch[NOTE:2] at 105 feet[NOTE:3] high;[NOTE:4] the gateway went all around to the jamb of the courtyard.
notes: The MT reads “jambs,” which does not make sense in context. Supposing a confusion of י (yod) for ו (vav), the text may be emended to read “porch.” See D. I. Block, Ezekiel (NICOT), 2:518.
The word “high” is not in the Hebrew text but is supplied for sense.

verses.zh: 从大门口到内廊前，共五十肘。
verses.en: From the front of the entrance gate to the porch of the inner gate was 87½ feet.[NOTE:1]

verses.zh: 卫房和门洞两旁柱间并廊子，都有严紧的窗棂；里边都有窗棂，柱上有雕刻的棕树。
verses.en: There were closed windows toward the alcoves and toward their jambs within the gate all around, and likewise for the porches. There were windows all around the inside, and on each jamb were decorative palm trees.[NOTE:1]
notes: Decorative palm trees were also a part of Solomon’s temple (1 Kgs 6:29, 32, 35).

verses.zh: 他带我到外院，见院的四围有铺石地；铺石地上有屋子三十间。
verses.en: Then he brought me to the outer court. I saw[NOTE:1] chambers there and a pavement made for the court all around; 30 chambers faced the pavement.
notes: The word הִנֵּה (hinneh, traditionally “behold”) indicates becoming aware of something and has been translated here as a verb.

verses.zh: 铺石地，就是矮铺石地在各门洞两旁，以门洞的长短为度。
verses.en: The pavement was beside the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates; this was the lower pavement.

verses.zh: 他从下门量到内院外，共宽一百肘，东面北面都是如此。
verses.en: Then he measured the width from before the lower gate to the front of the exterior of the inner court as 175 feet[NOTE:1] on the east and on the north.

verses.zh: 他量外院朝北的门，长宽若干。
verses.en: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court that faces north.

verses.zh: 门洞的卫房，这旁三间，那旁三间。门洞的柱子和廊子，与第一门的尺寸一样。门洞长五十肘，宽二十五肘。
verses.en: Its alcoves, three on each side, and its jambs and porches had the same measurement as the first gate; 87½ feet[NOTE:1] long and 43¾ feet[NOTE:2] wide.

verses.zh: 其窗棂和廊子，并雕刻的棕树，与朝东的门尺寸一样。登七层台阶上到这门，前面有廊子。
verses.en: Its windows, its porches, and its decorative palm trees had the same measurement as the gate that faced east. Seven steps led up to it, and its porch was in front of them.

verses.zh: 内院有门与这门相对，北面东面都是如此。他从这门量到那门，共一百肘。
verses.en: Opposite the gate on the north and the east was a gate of the inner court; he measured the distance from gate to gate at 175 feet.[NOTE:1]

verses.zh: 他带我往南去，见朝南有门，又照先前的尺寸量门洞的柱子和廊子。
verses.en: Then he led me toward the south. I saw[NOTE:1] a gate on the south. He measured its jambs and its porches; they had the same dimensions as the others.
notes: The word הִנֵּה (hinneh, traditionally “behold”) indicates becoming aware of something and has been translated here as a verb.

verses.zh: 门洞两旁与廊子的周围都有窗棂，和先量的窗棂一样。门洞长五十肘，宽二十五肘。
verses.en: There were windows all around it and its porches, like the windows of the others,[NOTE:1] 87½ feet[NOTE:2] long and 43¾ feet[NOTE:3] wide.

verses.zh: 登七层台阶上到这门，前面有廊子；柱上有雕刻的棕树，这边一棵，那边一棵。
verses.en: There were seven steps going up to it; its porches were in front of them. It had decorative palm trees on its jambs, one on either side.

verses.zh: 内院朝南有门。从这门量到朝南的那门，共一百肘。
verses.en: The inner court had a gate toward the south; he measured it from gate to gate toward the south as 175 feet.[NOTE:1]

verses.zh: 他带我从南门到内院，就照先前的尺寸量南门。
verses.en: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate; it had the same dimensions as the others.

verses.zh: 卫房和柱子，并廊子都照先前的尺寸。门洞两旁与廊子的周围都有窗棂。门洞长五十肘，宽二十五肘。
verses.en: Its alcoves, its jambs, and its porches had the same dimensions as the others, and there were windows all around it and its porches; its length was 87½ feet[NOTE:1] and its width 43¾ feet.[NOTE:2]

verses.zh: 周围有廊子，长二十五肘，宽五肘。
verses.en: There were porches all around, 43¾ feet[NOTE:1] long and 8¾ feet[NOTE:2] wide.

verses.zh: 廊子朝着外院，柱上有雕刻的棕树。登八层台阶上到这门。
verses.en: Its porches faced the outer court, and decorative palm trees were on its jambs, and its stairway had eight steps.

verses.zh: 他带我到内院的东面，就照先前的尺寸量东门。
verses.en: Then he brought me to the inner court on the east side. He measured the gate; it had the same dimensions as the others.

verses.zh: 卫房和柱子，并廊子都照先前的尺寸。门洞两旁与廊子的周围都有窗棂。门洞长五十肘，宽二十五肘。
verses.en: Its alcoves, its jambs, and its porches had the same dimensions as the others, and there were windows all around it and its porches; its length was 87½ feet[NOTE:1] and its width 43¾ feet.[NOTE:2]

verses.zh: 廊子朝着外院。门洞两旁的柱子都有雕刻的棕树。登八层台阶上到这门。
verses.en: Its porches faced the outer court, it had decorative palm trees on its jambs, and its stairway had eight steps.

verses.zh: 他带我到北门，就照先前的尺寸量那门，
verses.en: Then he brought me to the north gate, and he measured it; it had the same dimensions as the others—

verses.zh: 就是量卫房和柱子，并廊子。门洞周围都有窗棂；门洞长五十肘，宽二十五肘。
verses.en: its alcoves, its jambs, and its porches. It had windows all around it; its length was 87½ feet[NOTE:1] and its width 43¾ feet.[NOTE:2]

verses.zh: 廊柱朝着外院。门洞两旁的柱子都有雕刻的棕树。登八层台阶上到这门。
verses.en: Its jambs[NOTE:1] faced the outer court, and it had decorative palm trees on its jambs on either side, and its stairway had eight steps.

verses.zh: 门洞的柱旁有屋子和门；祭司（原文是他们）在那里洗燔祭牲。
verses.en: There was a chamber with its door by the porch of the gate;[NOTE:1] there they washed the burnt offering.
notes: The MT reads “jambs of the gates,” which does not make sense in a context discussing one chamber. The emendation to “porch” is similar to v. 14. See D. I. Block, Ezekiel (NICOT), 2:530.

verses.zh: 在门廊内，这边有两张桌子，那边有两张桌子，在其上可以宰杀燔祭牲、赎罪祭牲，和赎愆祭牲。
verses.en: In the porch of the gate were two tables on either side on which to slaughter the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering.

verses.zh: 上到朝北的门口，这边有两张桌子，门廊那边也有两张桌子。
verses.en: On the outside of the porch as one goes up at the entrance of the north gate were two tables, and on the other side of the porch of the gate were two tables.

verses.zh: 门这边有四张桌子，那边有四张桌子，共八张；在其上祭司宰杀牺牲。
verses.en: Four tables were on each side of the gate, eight tables on which the sacrifices were to be slaughtered.

verses.zh: 为燔祭牲有四张桌子，是凿过的石头做成的，长一肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘。祭司将宰杀燔祭牲和平安祭牲所用的器皿放在其上。
verses.en: The four tables for the burnt offering were of carved stone, 32 inches[NOTE:1] long, 32 inches[NOTE:2] wide, and 21 inches[NOTE:3] high. They would put the instruments that they used to slaughter the burnt offering and the sacrifice on them.

verses.zh: 有钩子，宽一掌，钉在廊内的四围。桌子上有牺牲的肉。
verses.en: There were hooks[NOTE:1] 3 inches[NOTE:2] long fastened in the house all around, and on the tables was the flesh of the offering.
notes: This reading is supported by the Aramaic Targum. The LXX, Vulgate, and Syriac read “shelves” or some type of projection.

verses.zh: 在北门旁，内院里有屋子，为歌唱的人而设。这屋子朝南（南：原文是东）；在南门旁，又有一间朝北。
verses.en: On the outside of the inner gate were chambers for the singers of the inner court, one[NOTE:1] at the side of the north gate facing south, and the other at the side of the south[NOTE:2] gate facing north.
notes: “One” is not in the Hebrew text but is supplied for clarity in the translation.
This reading is supported by the LXX; the MT reads “east.”

verses.zh: 他对我说：「这朝南的屋子是为看守殿宇的祭司；
verses.en: He said to me, “This chamber that faces south is for the priests who keep charge of the temple,[NOTE:1]

verses.zh: 那朝北的屋子是为看守祭坛的祭司。这些祭司是利未人中撒督的子孙，近前来事奉耶和华的。」
verses.en: and the chamber that faces north is for the priests who keep charge of the altar. These are the descendants of Zadok, from the descendants of Levi, who may approach the Lord to minister to him.”

verses.zh: 他又量内院，长一百肘，宽一百肘，是见方的。祭坛在殿前。
verses.en: He measured the court as a square 175 feet long and 175 feet wide;[NOTE:1] the altar was in front of the temple.
notes: Heb “100 cubits long and 100 cubits wide, a square” (i.e., 52.5 meters by 52.5 meters).

verses.zh: 于是他带我到殿前的廊子，量廊子的墙柱。这面厚五肘，那面厚五肘。门两旁，这边三肘，那边三肘。
verses.en: Then he brought me to the porch of the temple and measured the jambs of the porch as 8¾ feet[NOTE:1] on either side; the width of the gate was 24½ feet,[NOTE:2] and the sides[NOTE:3] were 5¼ feet[NOTE:4] on each side.
notes: The LXX reads “14 cubits” (i.e., 7.35 meters). See following note.
The translation follows the LXX. The MT reads: “the width of the gate was 3 cubits,” the omission due to haplography.tn Or “sidewalls.”

verses.zh: 廊子长二十肘，宽十一肘。上廊子有台阶。靠近墙柱又有柱子，这边一根，那边一根。
verses.en: The length of the porch was 35 feet[NOTE:1] and the width 19¼ feet;[NOTE:2] steps[NOTE:3] led up to it, and there were pillars beside the jambs on either side.
